# GRH Web Solutions

> GRH Web Solutions is a small digital studio based in Erie, Pennsylvania, run by Cody. It builds custom, mobile-first websites, manages social media for small businesses, and sets up AI chatbots and business automations. It also offers 1-on-1 DeFi and crypto education (educational only, not financial advice). It works with clients across the United States and worldwide.

Contact: call or text 740-319-2431 · cody@grhwebsolutions.com · free quote form at https://grhwebsolutions.com/#quote

## Services

- [Website Development](https://grhwebsolutions.com/services.html#web): custom-designed and coded sites (no templates or page builders), mobile-first, SEO foundation, e-commerce and booking systems. Most sites launch in under two weeks.
- [AI Business Integrations](https://grhwebsolutions.com/services.html#ai): AI chatbots and assistants, lead follow-up automation, CRM, email and calendar integrations, content pipelines.
- [Social Media Management](https://grhwebsolutions.com/services.html#social): content strategy and calendar, custom graphics and copywriting, scheduled posting, community engagement, growth tactics, monthly analytics. Platforms: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn.
- [DeFi Education](https://grhwebsolutions.com/defi.html): personalized sessions on wallet security, staking concepts, and navigating DEXs safely.

## Work

- [Groves Real Estate LLC](https://grovesrealestatellc.com): real estate company website.
- [Design Collective](https://designcollective.biz): website for a custom cabinetry business.
- [Groves Real Estate Painting](https://grovesrealestatepainting.com/): lead-generating service site with AI chat.

## How to start

A free 15-minute consultation to understand goals and recommend the right approach, then a custom strategy, build and launch, and ongoing support.
